protocol.name: Soluble TEV Protease Expression in E. coli
protocol.purpose: Express soluble S219V TEV protease from pRK793 in E. coli for downstream purification and use in fusion-tag cleavage.
materials: E. coli BL21(DE3) CodonPlus-RIL glycerol stock carrying pRK793

steps.text: Inoculate 50-150 mL LB broth containing 100 ug/mL ampicillin and 30 ug/mL chloramphenicol in a 500 mL baffled flask from a glycerol stock of BL21(DE3) CodonPlus-RIL/pRK793 cells. Incubate overnight at 37°C with shaking at 250 rpm.

For each 1 L expression culture, inoculate 1 L fresh LB broth containing 100 ug/mL ampicillin, 30 ug/mL chloramphenicol, and 0.2% glucose in a 4 L baffled flask with 25 mL saturated overnight culture. A typical preparation uses 4-6 L total culture.
Grow the cultures at 37°C with shaking at 250 rpm until mid-log phase, OD600 about 0.5, which is approximately 2 h.

Shift the cultures to 30°C and induce with IPTG to 1 mM final concentration using 5 mL of 200 mM IPTG stock per liter of culture. Continue shaking at 250 rpm for 4-6 h, then place the cultures at 4°C.
Harvest cells by centrifugation at 5,000 x g for 10 min at 4°C. Store the cell pellet at -80°C until purification. A 6 L preparation typically yields 30-40 g cell paste.

protocol.troubleshooting:
Low soluble TEV protease: reduce the culture temperature from 37°C to 30°C immediately before IPTG induction; this temperature shift is reported to keep virtually all processed TEV protease soluble.
Low overall yield: use BL21(DE3) CodonPlus-RIL cells and maintain 30 ug/mL chloramphenicol selection during growth; the pRIL rare-tRNA plasmid is reported to dramatically increase TEV protease yield.
